release: Komorebi Physics Lean v0.26.0 — Checked Block 26

claims.claim: Two fine geometric translations equal one lifted coarse translation.
Ordered half-link reconstruction and covariant midpoint interpolation give exact two-fine-step/coarse-step Clifford intertwining.
claims.scope: Any one Clifford involution and one edge direction.

claims.claim: The geometric interpolation and subdivided links are gauge covariant with independent endpoint and midpoint gauges.
Half-cell weighting makes interpolation Hilbert-isometric; averaging restriction is its adjoint.
claims.scope: Finite site types and four-spinor state space.

claims.claim: A factorwise refined one-axis M-S-M walk exactly intertwines with the coarse walk and preserves the fine weighted inner product.
claims.scope: Local half-step square root plus one directional Clifford shift.

claims.claim: Plaquette flatness is equivalent to path-independent corner transport, and plaquette holonomy is gauge invariant for commuting translations.
claims.scope: Two abelian link directions with common corner endpoint.

claims.claim: There exists an explicit nonflat finite witness with plaquette equal to -1.

nonclaims: No full three-dimensional fine/coarse seven-factor intertwining theorem is claimed.
No operator-norm bound proportional to curvature is yet proved.
No summable geometric refinement defect across arbitrarily many scales is yet proved.
No L2 continuum Dirac convergence theorem is claimed.
No dynamical gauge-field, gravitational, or cosmological equations are claimed.
